gates.name: Fixed generator corpus and compatibility identity
gates.notes: Fixed seed/version/fingerprint digest; accidental baseline drift fails loudly.

gates.name: Byte-identical deterministic output across 0/1/2/4/8 workers
gates.notes: Runs the existing authoritative standalone mesh/reconstruction hash regression unchanged through 0, 1, 2, 4 and 8 worker configurations.

gates.name: Bounded sealed-volume termination rule
gates.notes: A 27-cell room is open/truncated at budget 27 and sealed when allowed to terminate at budget 28; breach remains open.

gates.name: Sparse persistence compatibility and corruption rejection
gates.notes: Negative compatibility/corruption rejection is paired with the existing positive transactional round-trip/journal persistence regression, now individually addressable.

gates.name: Stable address-keyed infrastructure validation
gates.notes: Zero stable IDs, payload-kind mismatches, and payload-carrying tombstones are rejected; broad cross-shard closure/tombstone regressions remain in the existing headless suite.

gates.name: Backend-neutral renderer stub lifetime
gates.notes: Fake backend rejects destroyed handles and broad renderer cache/lifetime tests pass. Real OpenGL/Raylib behavior is not proven by this row.

gates.name: Third Edition Gate 0 - reproducible foundation
gates.notes: Clean headless source configure/build plus the complete suite, fixed generator corpus, persistence rejection, and exact 0/1/2/4/8 worker mesh determinism are required.

gates.name: Third Edition Gate 1 - tactile planet
gates.notes: Headless cube-face seam traversal, local authored-obstacle detour, microvoxel/LOD/meshing and collision contracts execute. The authoritative 25/43/0 wall fixture remains external to this standalone tree; real movement feel/GPU continuity remain native proof.

gates.name: Third Edition Gate 2 - survival/base loop
gates.notes: Atmosphere/airlock, industry/logistics, and persistence are separately runnable headless proofs. Full player-facing crafting/survival usability still requires native integration/playtest.

gates.name: Third Edition Gate 3 - consequence loop
gates.notes: Register Action announcement/waves/stable IDs/persistence/beacon-failure behavior are individually runnable headless proof. Full standing/claim/combat integration and native siege play remain outside this standalone proof.

gates.name: Third Edition Gate 4 - travel loop
gates.notes: No dedicated headless end-to-end ship repair/takeoff/travel/return acceptance sequence exists in this Part Two checkpoint.

gates.name: Third Edition Gate 5 - slice content/presentation
gates.notes: Requires content breadth, UI/audio/onboarding and a 30-60 minute instrumented playtest; not a headless-only claim.

gates.name: Fourth Edition Phase 0 - ECS substrate and persistence
gates.notes: Stable object/persistence contracts are present, but the full Fourth Edition StableId entity serialization plus active-remote-active shard promotion model is not implemented in this standalone tree.

gates.name: Fourth Edition Phase 1 - seven-person outpost
gates.notes: Citizen population, autonomous fortress jobs, stockpiles, hospital loop and military squad integration are not implemented in this standalone Part Two checkpoint.

gates.name: Fourth Edition Phase 2 - functioning fortress
gates.notes: Work details/orders, citizen mind/relationships, institutions, migration/trade and incident breadth are future integration work here.

gates.name: Fourth Edition Phase 3 - consequences and history
gates.notes: The standalone Register Action slice exists, but justice, infiltration, artifacts, Chronicle and retire/reclaim are not yet present.

gates.name: Fourth Edition Phase 4 - multi-site civilization
gates.notes: Remote outposts, orbital/inter-site logistics, diplomacy and civilization history are outside this checkpoint.
